description: This file defines a global store for a furniture shopping web application, managing application state such as products, cart, and UI states using the Blits library.

methods.name: loadProducts
methods.description: Asynchronously loads product data from API or mock data, updating the store state accordingly.

methods.name: setSelectedProductById
methods.description: Sets the currently selected product based on its ID.

methods.name: addToCart
methods.description: Adds a specified product to the shopping cart, increasing quantity if it already exists.

methods.name: removeFromCart
methods.description: Removes a product from the cart by its ID.

methods.name: updateQty
methods.description: Updates the quantity of a specific cart item.

methods.name: placeOrder
methods.description: Mocks placing an order, generates an order ID, resets the cart, and updates relevant states.
